title: Scheduling Data to Compute: Hierarchical Data Pipelining for LLM Training on AMD GPUs
abstract: arXiv:2611.05751v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLM) have been the key focus of recent machine learning breakthroughs. As the model size grows exponentially, the computation needed for training is astronomical. A GPU can do a huge amount of arithmetic. However, the data its compute units need is not always available when they are ready. This data may still be in slow memory or on another GPU. While the chip waits, expensive compute sits idle, and at scale even a small drop in utilization translates into substantial cost. In this paper, we treat this waiting time as the primary bottleneck. We focus on hardware features designed for explicit data movement. These features load data from off-chip memory onto the chip, rearrange it into the layout the computation requires as it is loaded, and transfer it between GPUs. translated_title: 面向计算的数据调度：用于AMD GPU上LLM训练的层次化数据流水线
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为近期机器学习突破的核心焦点。随着模型规模呈指数级增长，训练所需的计算量达到了天文数字级别。GPU能够执行海量的算术运算，但其计算单元所需的数据并不总是在计算单元就绪时可用。这些数据可能仍处于慢速内存中，或位于另一个GPU上。当芯片处于等待状态时，昂贵的计算资源便被闲置，而在大规模部署下，即使是利用率的微小下降也会转化为巨大的成本。在本文中，我们将这种等待时间视为主要瓶颈。我们专注于为显式数据移动而设计的硬件特性。这些特性将数据从片外内存加载到芯片上，并在加载过程中将其重排为计算所需的布局，同时在GPU之间传输数据。通过编排这些硬件特性，我们保持了稳定的数据流水线持续流向计算单元，使其保持忙碌。我们提出了内核和框架实现……
tldr: 该论文将LLM训练中计算单元的数据等待时间视为核心瓶颈，提出通过编排AMD GPU上用于显式数据移动的硬件特性（数据加载、布局重排与GPU间传输），构建层次化数据流水线，使计算单元持续保持忙碌，从而提升训练效率与利用率。
en_tdlr: This paper treats data-waiting time as the primary bottleneck in LLM training and proposes hierarchical data pipelining that orchestrates AMD GPU hardware features for explicit data movement—loading, layout rearrangement, and inter-GPU transfer—to keep compute units continuously busy and maximize utilization.
